name: Parking sensor on its own
blurb: Works by itself with the little screen, but this website won't be able to talk to it. This is the restore point — flashing it puts the board back how it started.
lede: The same parking sensor, but standalone: no computer needed once it's flashed. The screen and the buzzer do everything. Live view stays empty because this version doesn't send anything back.

components.label: Distance sensor
components.what: Sends out a click and times the echo

components.label: LED light
components.what: Lights up when something is close

components.label: Buzzer
components.what: Beeps faster the closer you get
